d: DMF-CI-8 DigitalMedia™ Card Chassis for DM-NVX-C & DMCF, 8 Slots

specs.label: USB Host
specs.value: For loading of firmware via a USB mass storage device

specs.label: CARD SLOT ID 1 – 8
specs.value: (8) Card slots; Each slot accepts (1) DM-NVX-C series encoder/decoder card or (1) DMCF series transmitter or receiver card

specs.label: USB (front)
specs.value: (1) USB Type A female; Supports USB mass storage devices for firmware update

specs.label: Enclosure chassis
specs.value: Metal with black finish, vented sides, fan-cooled

specs.label: Front Panel
specs.value: Metal, black finish with polycarbonate label overlay

specs.label: Enclosure mounting
specs.value: Freestanding or 2 RU 19-inch rack-mountable (rack ears included)
